title: Vietnamese Pudding Rice Bowl
description: A comforting and flavorful dessert bowl featuring garlicky Vietnamese pudding over a bed of rice.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a separate saucepan, combine the garlicky pudding mix, kissed coconut milk, sugar, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Serve the pudding over the cooked rice.
Optional: garnish with additional kissed coconut milk, if desired.
